<thought>The monoisotopic peak at m/z 114.06808 corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈113.0608 Da. A formula that matches this mass and the observed isotopic pattern (≈6.7 % M+1 and ≈0.6 % M+2, consistent with ~6 carbons and two oxygens) is C₆H₉O₂. This formula predicts a monoisotopic mass of 113.0603 Da, within <0.001 Da of the measured value, and its isotopic distribution aligns with the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
